skill.name: senior-architect
skill.description: Architecture review skill for system design, technology decisions, and implementation planning. It includes reference guides and Python helper scripts for basic project, dependency, and architecture reports.
skill.summary: Plan and review software architecture with reference guides and basic helper scripts.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, network activity, or obfuscated behavior was found in the reviewed files. Most static hits are Markdown fences or reference links. Confirmed risks are optional JSON report file writes and broad command examples that can modify local or deployment state if run without approval.

remediation.suggestion: Restrict --output to the project workspace, refuse overwrites by default, and show the write target before execution.
Require explicit user approval before npm, pip, Docker, Docker Compose, or kubectl commands. Avoid automatic execution.

remediation.issue: Environment file creation can overwrite local configuration
remediation.suggestion: Replace cp .env.example .env with a no-clobber command and warn users before changing existing .env files.

content.value_statement: Architecture decisions are hard to compare when patterns, trade-offs, and tooling live in separate notes. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused architecture checklist with scripts and references.
actual_capabilities: Documents architecture patterns, system design workflows, and technology decision criteria.
Provides three Python command-line scripts for architecture, dependency, and project review workflows.
Validates a target path before running script reports.
Prints basic report status and finding counts for reviewed targets.
Can write JSON report output to a user-selected file.
Summarizes common stacks for web, mobile, backend, database, DevOps, and cloud projects.
limitations: The scripts are scaffolds and do not inspect source files deeply.
Reference files contain generic examples and placeholder pattern names.
No built-in renderer creates visual architecture diagrams.
Command examples require trusted projects and explicit approval.

use_cases.title: Plan an MVP Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare stack choices, service boundaries, and early scaling risks before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Review Platform Changes
use_cases.description: Assess integration points, operational impact, and dependency risks for a proposed platform change.

use_cases.title: Prepare Decision Notes
use_cases.description: Turn architecture trade-offs into clear notes for review, approval, and future maintenance.

prompt_templates.title: Map Current System
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this project architecture. Identify main components, data flows, risks, and three improvements. Use only the files I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Stack Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these technology options for my product. Score fit, complexity, operations, hiring, and cost. Recommend one option with clear trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Review Architecture Risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed system design for scalability, security, and maintainability. List risks, mitigations, and questions for the team.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Decision Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an architecture decision package for this initiative. Include context, constraints, options, trade-offs, migration plan, and review checkpoints.

output_examples.input: I need to choose between REST and GraphQL for a mobile product.
output_examples.output: A decision brief comparing integration complexity, caching, client flexibility, team skill, and operational cost, with a recommended path.

output_examples.input: Review our Next.js and Postgres architecture before launch.
output_examples.output: A launch readiness review covering service boundaries, database scaling risks, observability gaps, and immediate fixes.

output_examples.input: Generate an architecture review from a target path.
output_examples.output: A basic script report showing the selected target, status, and finding count.

best_practices: Provide project goals, constraints, and expected traffic before asking for architecture guidance.
Ask for trade-offs and decision records, not only a final recommendation.
Review any generated command before running it in a real workspace.
anti_patterns: Do not run setup, Docker, or Kubernetes commands without checking the target project.
Do not treat placeholder reference text as complete production guidance.
Do not overwrite report files or environment files without a backup.

faq.question: Does this skill generate real architecture diagrams?
faq.answer: It includes a diagram generator script scaffold, but it does not render visual diagrams by itself.

faq.question: Can it inspect my whole codebase automatically?
faq.answer: The included scripts validate target paths and print basic reports. Deep code inspection depends on the agent using the skill.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production architecture reviews?
faq.answer: Use it as a structured checklist and starting point. Human review is still needed for production decisions.

faq.question: Does it make technology decisions automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps compare options and trade-offs, then presents a recommendation for review.

faq.question: What should I check before running commands?
faq.answer: Confirm the target path, review package scripts, and avoid deployment commands without explicit approval.
